reconstruction.graphs: Every view of each captured animation block, projectile export and projectile shadow. Empty locators and text fields remain nonpainting nodes.
reconstruction.shadows: The single black-RGB shape with nonzero alpha in each character file is recorded as its original ground shadow for separate rendering.
reconstruction.previews: Frame zero of the idle row (view 3 when directional), two pixels per native unit, conservative export bounds, eight-pixel icon padding. Registration is local.
